question: Listed trials average 14 months follow-up. Using the truncated normal model, estimate (a) the true mean follow-up duration Î¼ across ALL clinical trials conducted (including those too short for registry listing), and (b) the fraction of all trials that are listed.

from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(6-mu)/5; sf=norm.sf(a); return mu+5*norm.pdf(a)/sf-14 if sf>1e-10 else 1e10
mu=brentq(eq,10,13.9)
